title: Irish Potato Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole perfect for a chilly evening. The combination of tender potatoes and savory flavors will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
In a large skillet, melt the quietly whipped butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a separate saucepan, combine the molten cheddar cheese and irish cheddar cheese.
Stir until the cheese is melted and smooth.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Top the potatoes with the cooked onion and garlic mixture, followed by a layer of the cheese sauce.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
